tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: MASS. Page, surface and panel background. The only background a non-inverted element may have. Pure by definition.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: MASS. Primary text, display type, control borders, focus rings, glyph icons, and the fill of an inverted slab or primary button. 21:1 on `ground`. Pure by definition.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: SECONDARY ONLY. Secondary text, mono labels, metadata, placeholders — on `ground` only (7.1:1 dark, 7.0:1 light). Never a fill, never display type, never inside a slab (use `on-slab-muted`).

tokens.name: on-slab-muted
tokens.usage: SECONDARY ONLY. Secondary text inside an inverted slab or primary button when the slab is drawn with the `ink` fill fallback (7.0:1 on white, 7.1:1 on black). Unneeded when the slab carries a flipped data-theme — then use `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: SECONDARY ONLY. Lines that carry meaning: default Frame stroke, Field border at rest, table row separators, back-edges of wireframes (4.4:1 dark, 3.5:1 light on `ground`).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: SECONDARY ONLY. Decorative hairlines: column guides, SpecList inner dividers, section rules that only structure. Never the only cue for a state.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: SECONDARY ONLY. Background patterns only: line grid (dark), dot grid (light), CRT scanlines. Never text, never a border, never a fill block.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: SECONDARY ONLY. Disabled text and disabled control strokes. Exempt from contrast by WCAG; always paired with a disabled cursor and aria-disabled.

styles.name: t-display-xl
styles.usage: One per view: hero headline, slide cover title. Weight 500 on dark, 600 on light (bundle.css). Sentence case.

styles.name: t-display-l
styles.usage: Section headline on web, slide headline, big metrics.

styles.name: t-heading
styles.usage: Sub-section heading, panel title on slides.

styles.name: t-caps
styles.usage: Editorial-brutalist heading: UPPERCASE (bundle.css), weight 700. Bracketed slide titles (Heading), panel titles on Print slides, magazine-style section heads. Pair with a mono subtitle (`cn-heading__sub`). For giant brutalist caps use `t-display-xl` / `t-display-l` + `.cn-caps`.

styles.name: t-title
styles.usage: Card / Frame title, list-item title, UI view title.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: The node keeps no state between sessions.
styles.usage: Running text. Never below 16px in Rajdhani; anything smaller is set in mono.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE always (bundle.css). Indices, tags, nav, button labels, axis labels, metadata.

styles.name: t-data
styles.usage: Numbers in tables, coordinates, code, logs, timestamps. Tabular figures by nature.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-text gap, tag inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control, label-to-field gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding, list row padding, gap between tags.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gutter, Frame padding, gap between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Slab padding, page side margin on UI, gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side margin on web and slides, gap between sections inside a view.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between web sections.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner in the system. There is no other radius. Corners are either square or chamfered (see `chamfer-*`).

chamfer.note: 45-degree corner cut. Only the top-right corner is ever cut; a Frame may also cut bottom-left. Implemented with clip-path in bundle.css (.cn-cut, .cn-cut-2).

tokens.name: chamfer-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, solid tags.

tokens.name: chamfer-md
tokens.usage: Frames, Fields' focus state, UI panels.

tokens.name: chamfer-lg
tokens.usage: Slabs, hero frames, slide panels.

stroke.note: Line weights. No other weights exist.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Every border, rule, guide, tracker box and wireframe edge.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Section-opening rule on light (print) expression; error-state Field border.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, solid `ink`, offset 3px (or inset 4px on clipped controls).

tokens.name: layout-max
tokens.usage: Max content width on web.

tokens.name: layout-columns
tokens.usage: Column count; gutters are `space-4`.

tokens.name: layout-slide-w
tokens.usage: Slide canvas width (16:9).

tokens.name: layout-slide-h
tokens.usage: Slide canvas height (16:9).

tokens.name: layout-slide-margin-print
tokens.usage: Side margin on Print (white-primary) slides — the denser, PDF-derived layout. Signal slides keep `space-6` (64px).

tokens.name: layout-construct-ext
tokens.usage: How far construction lines overshoot an asset's edges; leave at least this much free space around a Construct.

tempo.note: Motion timing. Everything is stepped (steps()/setInterval), never eased. bundle.js reads these as --tempo-*.

tokens.name: tempo-frame
tokens.usage: One frame of a generative loop = 12 fps (Matter, Scope, GlyphMass, Lens, Trail, BlobTrack, FlipDot, Progress; Ticker ×1.5).

tokens.name: tempo-tick
tokens.usage: One step of Decode and Counter (12–16 steps).

tokens.name: tempo-char
tokens.usage: One typed character (Reveal type; Terminal commands ×1.6).

tokens.name: tempo-step
tokens.usage: One step of a wipe or dither reveal (6–8 steps ≈ 0.4–0.5 s).

tokens.name: tempo-blink
tokens.usage: Cursor and LIVE blink period (steps(1)).

tokens.name: tempo-hold
tokens.usage: Pause before a loop restarts (Terminal, sequences).
